Asset roles:
<Picture 1>
First-frame reference: side-rear Chinese 3D animation battle scene in a daylight mountain valley. A young blond, blue-eyed knight rides a black warhorse, surrounded by a vastly larger formation of heavily equipped bandits on the same level of the valley floor.
<Picture 2>
Character turnaround reference: young blond, blue-eyed knight in polished silver plate armor, blue-and-red eagle crest shield, longsword and radiant energy sword form. Keep his face, hairstyle, armor, shield and weapon completely consistent.

A low side-rear camera reveals the knight and warhorse trapped inside a tightening ring of bandits. Dozens of armored bandits close in from the front, sides and rear, raising shields, spears, axes and crossbows. The knight looks briefly over his shoulder, clearly outnumbered, then draws his sword as it expands into a brilliant gold-white radiant energy blade. Bandits attack simultaneously from multiple directions. The knight raises his shield to block a spear thrust, pivots with the horse, and cuts through two attackers while another axe strikes his shield from behind. The warhorse kicks backward to create space, but more bandits immediately fill the gap. The knight releases a crescent energy slash that knocks back several enemies, yet the formation remains overwhelmingly dense. Dust, sparks and broken weapons fill the enclosed battlefield as the knight forces a narrow opening toward the valley route.
